name: Enrich LinkedIn profiles into Google Sheets with Periodix Actions

parameters.content:
## Enrich LinkedIn profiles in Google Sheets with Periodix Actions

Paste LinkedIn profile URLs into a Google Sheet and get back full structured profiles: current role and company, past roles, education, skills, languages, summary, and open profile and premium flags. Ready for CRM import, ICP scoring, or personalized outreach.

Enrich 1,000 profiles for $10 a month: 18x less than a $185 Clay plan and about half of Apify's $19 Starter plan with popular LinkedIn scrapers at $7 to $10 per 1,000. No run fees, no cookies, and no actor that breaks or changes its output fields when LinkedIn changes.

### How it works
1. Reads LinkedIn profile URLs from the Input tab.
2. Skips anyone already in the Enriched tab, so you can rerun it safely.
3. Periodix Actions fetches each full profile, with profile-view notifications turned off.
4. Each profile is flattened into clean columns and appended to the Enriched tab.

### Setup
1. Install the verified Periodix Actions node (works on n8n Cloud and self-hosted), sign up at actions.periodix.net, connect a LinkedIn profile, and pick it in Get Profile.
2. Create a Google Sheet with two tabs: Input (column: linkedin_url) and Enriched (columns: linkedin_url, public_identifier, provider_id, first_name, last_name, headline, location, current_title, current_company, current_role_since, past_roles, education, skills, languages, summary, open_profile, premium, network_distance, followers, status, enriched_at).
3. Connect Google Sheets and set your Sheet ID in all three Sheets nodes.

### Customization
Swap the last node for HubSpot, Notion, or your CRM. Add an AI step after Normalize Profile to score each person against your ICP. For large lists, switch to a Schedule Trigger: Get Profile enriches up to 100 profiles per day per connected LinkedIn profile, and each run continues where the last one stopped.

### Pricing
From $10/month per connected LinkedIn profile with 1,000 results included, and every next 2,000 results for just $10. Or $49/month unlimited. Each enriched profile counts as one result.

Built on the infrastructure behind Periodix (rated 4.9/5 on G2): 0 LinkedIn accounts lost across 25,000 connected profiles in the last 24 months.

### 1. Read and dedupe
Reads LinkedIn profile URLs from the Input tab and skips anyone already in the Enriched tab, so reruns never enrich the same person twice.

### 2. Enrich and save
Periodix Actions returns the full profile. Normalize Profile flattens current role, past roles, education, skills, and languages into clean columns for the Enriched tab.
